title: UWell Caliburn G3 Pod Vape Device
description:
Description
Specifications
This Kit Includes
The UWell Caliburn G3 Pod Vape Device is a new and improved version of the incredibly popular Caliburn G2! It is a low-maintenance vape that is ideal for beginners and experienced vapers alike. It’s 900mAh built-in battery will provide enough charge for long vaping sessions and the 5-25W output is ideal for RDTL (Restricted Direct To Lung) and MTL (Mouth To Lung) vaping. This kit is compatible with the UWell Caliburn G3 Replacement Pod and two are included to get you started. The UWell Caliburn G3 Pod Vape Device features a single button, making it easy to set up and vape. In addition, this is the first pod system among the Caliburn G series featuring an OLED display. Precise power adjustment, puff recording, and trigger lock mode help to customize vaping journey for users via the large trigger button.
Additional features include a convenient e-liquid viewing window to avoid burnt coils, 2ml e-liquid capacity pods, and a unique dial airflow system.
